row.notes: Sub-parser of Sess_Parse_PlayerDescription (0x1427b8db0) for a player's car state JSON (param_1[0] = player description obj, param_2 = JSON): strategy {compound, tyreSetIndex, expectedLaps, maximumLaps, stopWindowEarliestLap, stopWindowIdealLap, stopWindowLatestLap} -> obj+0x1c8 (0x14136b330); engineWear {wearICE, wearTC, wearES, wearMGUH, wearMGUK, wearCE}; detailedTyreWear {perTyreWear, perTyrePunctured -> +0x1b0, perTyreBurst -> +0x1b8}, flag +0x1a0; fastestLap; wingDamage, bodyDamage, detailedBodyDamage. Called twice (default desc and override when flags&2). Addon: start a session with preset tyre strategy, engine wear and damage (scenario/challenge setups, mid-race starts).
